mapper.update: UPDATE tb_shop_initialization_task SET employee_initialized = 1 WHERE shop_id = #{id} AND attempt = #{attempt}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_messages WHERE shop_id = #{id} AND msg_type = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_shop (shop_name, admin_account, admin_password) VALUES (#{shopName}, #{adminAccount}, #{adminPassword}) ON CONFLICT(shop_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT task.*, shop.init_status FROM tb_shop_initialization_task task JOIN tb_shop shop ON shop.id = task.shop_id WHERE task.shop_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_shop SET init_status = #{status}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = #{id} AND init_status = #{expected}

UPDATE tb_shop SET init_status = #{initStatus}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = #{id} AND init_status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_shop_initialization_task task WHERE task.shop_id = #{id} AND task.attempt = #{attempt})
UPDATE tb_shop_initialization_task SET failure_code = #{failureCode} WHERE shop_id = #{id} AND attempt = #{attempt}
mapper.select: SELECT task.*, shop.init_status FROM tb_shop_initialization_task task JOIN tb_shop shop ON shop.id = task.shop_id WHERE shop.init_status = 'PENDING' AND task.deadline_epoch_ms <= #{now} ORDER BY task.deadline_epoch_ms LIMIT 100
